title: Prefer the native trivial capability
why: A new dependency used once for an operation already provided by the declared runtime adds supply-chain and maintenance cost without owning behavior.
suggestion: Use the named native operation unless the dependency supplies behavior the call site actually requires.
limitations: Requires a newly added package.json production dependency, one import, one use, and an explicit semantics-preserving capability mapping.
Recognizes left-pad via String.padStart and object-assign via Object.assign.
Recognizes node-fetch and abort-controller globals only when package.json declares Node.js 18 or newer.
Runs only for focused changes touching at most five production source files.
